name: Claude Code
description: Claude Code in a panel on the right: a conversation in Markdown with Ask, Read and Edit modes, its permission questions as buttons; the selection or file referenced in it, a review in Problems and a selection rewritten in place. Needs Claude Code installed and signed in; written in Rust, built once with cargo.

requires.for: the chat, review and rewrite: Claude Code, installed and signed in (claude auth login)
